news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.58 (up from ₹1.61 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹269.7m (up 50% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹12.2m (up 60% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.5% (up from 4.3% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 80% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 25% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
